provenance.note: Append-only union of every rolling window this scraper has caught, keyed by observation timestamp so re-runs are idempotent.

_doc: Durable archive of SMC's rolling flood-chain window.
SMC publishes ~10 readings and no archive, so this file is the
only record that the readings before today ever existed. It grows
by whatever the daily job catches and has no pre-history.
